updates.title: Microsoft Purview Network Data Security: General Availability with Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: Data Loss Prevention policies now integrate with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to protect sensitive data at the network layer across text, files, and AI interactions, blocking risky sharing to unmanaged cloud apps and social platforms. This GA capability enforces DLP actions and detects insider risk activity across browsers, apps, APIs, and add-ins.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps (Preview)
updates.summary: Organizations can now create DLP policies that protect sensitive data at rest in third-party applications like Box and Google Workspace using existing Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors. This extends DLP classification capabilities beyond Microsoft 365 to govern data in connected SaaS platforms.

updates.title: Endpoint DLP for macOS 27: Permission Changes Preparation
updates.summary: Admins must deploy Endpoint DLP client version 101.26072 or later to prepare for upcoming permission model changes on macOS, including configuration of protection modes and monitoring of Device Control and Data Access permissions. This proactive measure ensures continuity of endpoint DLP enforcement on Apple devices.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management: 30-Day Delay Hold Applied to Inactive Mailboxes
updates.summary: When the last hold is removed from an inactive mailbox, Microsoft 365 now automatically applies a 30-day delay hold to ensure compliance and provide time for admins to review. Admins must now monitor and manually clear these delay holds before recalculating mailbox hold status.

updates.title: Remove Retention Hold from Unlicensed OneDrive Sites via PowerShell
updates.summary: Security & Compliance PowerShell now supports removal of retention holds from unlicensed OneDrive sites, enabling tenant-level and site-level hold management without requiring direct UI access. This capability helps admins unblock site deletion for departed users or unused accounts.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management: Priority Cleanup for SharePoint and OneDrive Files (Preview)
updates.summary: A new Priority Cleanup capability allows admins to permanently delete selected files from SharePoint and OneDrive after simulation and approval, bypassing recycle bins so files are no longer searchable. This streamlines compliance workflows for sensitive or regulated data requiring hard deletion.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DSPM: Copilot Readiness and Data Explorer (In Development)
updates.summary: New Copilot readiness assessment and data explorer tools are coming to Purview Data Security Posture Management to help organizations evaluate sensitive data exposure, oversharing, and protection coverage in preparation for Microsoft Copilot deployments. These insights help teams prioritize remediation of data security gaps.

updates.title: Adaptive Protection Integrates with Data Lifecycle Management (In Development)
updates.summary: Purview's Adaptive Protection will automatically apply retention labels based on dynamic insider risk levels, moving users in and out of retention policies as their risk profile changes over time. This integration ensures high-risk user data is preserved while low-risk user data follows standard retention schedules.

updates.title: Data Security Investigations: Analyze Files from Endpoint DLP Alerts (Launched)
updates.summary: Admins can now launch Data Security Investigations directly from endpoint DLP alerts to rapidly analyze exfiltrated content by defining time ranges, users, and endpoints; the system automatically gathers related files that triggered alerts. This accelerates incident response for endpoint data loss events.

updates.title: Information Protection: Auto-Labeling Per-Policy Coverage Report (In Development)
updates.summary: Admins will gain per-policy visibility into auto-labeling enforcement progress, including file counts that were labeled, not yet labeled, or found during enforcement but not in the last simulation. This helps identify labeling gaps and understand the real-world impact of auto-labeling policies.

updates.title: Insider Risk Management: Reduce Temporary File Noise for Endpoint Activities (In Development)
updates.summary: A new feature will help Insider Risk Management customers filter temporary file activity noise from Windows and applications by enhancing exclusion patterns beyond current file type and path filters. This reduces low-signal events and improves signal-to-noise ratio in insider risk investigations.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management: Auto-Delete OneDrives and Mailboxes for Departed Employees (In Development)
updates.summary: Admins will be able to automatically delete both content and containers for departed users at scale, eliminating manual cleanup and helping organizations maintain regulatory compliance without ongoing administrative overhead. This streamlines offboarding workflows.

updates.title: eDiscovery: In-Product Diagnostics for Troubleshooting (In Development)
updates.summary: Self-service diagnostics will help eDiscovery admins identify and resolve common configuration issues with case permissions, security filters, and policy status without external support. This embedded troubleshooting reduces misconfiguration issues and improves case setup reliability.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management: Sensitive Data Insights and Policy Recommendations (In Development)
updates.summary: Purview will provide insights and recommendations on sensitive data stored in OneDrive and SharePoint, helping organizations craft retention policies that balance compliance and data security posture. This guidance improves governance of high-risk information.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention: Island Enterprise Browser Integration for Unmanaged Cloud Apps (In Development)
updates.summary: Purview Network Data Security will integrate with Island Enterprise Browser to detect and protect data shared with unmanaged cloud apps through HTTP/HTTPS using existing Purview classifiers, sensitive information types, and labels. This extends DLP coverage to browser-based workflows at the point of user interaction.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management: Legacy Teams Retention Policies Converted to Teams-Only Scope (In Development)
updates.summary: Existing retention policies scoped to Microsoft Teams that currently also apply to Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions will be converted to Teams-only policies, no longer implicitly governing Copilot workloads. Admins should review and adjust Copilot-specific retention policies separately if needed.
